front: Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: individual orthographic input for Meshy multi-image-to-3D, not a new creature design. The attached image is the edit target and source concept sheet for M-07. Extract ONLY the requested complete body from its upper-row orthographic panel. Preserve exactly this creature's original anatomy, low bowed head, wet pale gray skin, clustered eye-like sensory head with vestigial human face, extremely elongated arms, distinct five fingers, elongated legs and splayed feet, weathered numbered collar, single metal wrist restraint, back monitoring ports, and the overlapping six thin blue-gray veined organic gill mantle lamellae attached to the shoulders/back. Preserve panel pose and view with both feet and all membrane tips in frame. This mantle is living tissue, never fabric or clothing. Remove all surrounding sheet, paper texture, labels, border lines, floor shadows, and every other figure. Actual transparent background. Single centered full-body subject, consistent scale matching the original sheet, soft neutral lighting preserving surface appearance. Do not add human scale silhouettes or separate closeups. Do not invent geometry, extra limbs, leaves, wings, armor, or glow. No surrounding captions. Only retain numbering that is physically on the original collar. Requested view: exact front-facing full-body figure in the upper middle-left panel labeled 正视 (approximately original sheet x=550..889, y=49..569). Front orthographic view, the entire creature looking down, chest facing camera. Do not use the large three-quarter hero scene on the left.
